# provider-adapter-kit

> Uniform text-completion adapters for the Anthropic Messages, Gemini generateContent and OpenAI-compatible chat APIs over an injected HTTP transport, with one error model. Python package `trysac-provider-adapter-kit`, import name `provider_adapter_kit`, MIT licensed, Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): problem, install, usage example, public API, limits, and errors
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): shape of the package, public API, transport, and error model
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): the visible test module and the cases it covers
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): defended and not-defended threats with code limits
- [Project](docs/PROJECT.md): objective, scope, out-of-scope, and effort metrics
